alerts.title: NGINX CVE-2026-42945 Exploited in the Wild, Causing Worker Crashes and Possible RCE

cve_details.description: NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source have a vulnerability in the ngx_http_rewrite_module module. This vulnerability exists when the rewrite directive is followed by a rewrite, if, or set directive and an unnamed Perl-Compatible Regular Expression (PCRE) capture (for example, $1, $2) with a replacement string that includes a question mark (?).
